items.title: Prepare and verify Desk article images before email delivery

executionLog.note: Local command/readiness/producer/dispatch acceptance and independent review verified; combined focused72 pass. No actual generation/send or deployment claimed.

items.why: Founder-requested image preparation before marketing/subscriber mail.
items.userOutcome: Recipients see the reviewed article imagery in email and linked articles; missing or unverified art holds delivery rather than sending an incomplete issue.
items.stageRationale: Explicit founder extension within S413; preserve supported-release cadence, email arming, identity, pricing and provider constraints.
items.recipe: Add a builtins-only shared desk-email-art module. Accept explicit root/day/selected-story inputs, derive canonical article-bound source/derivative paths, require real reviewed banner metadata with matching source hash, reject procedural fallback, missing/unreviewed/unknown/drifted inputs, and validate declared satire using the existing optional-cartoon contract. Do not equate semanticVerified:false with rejection or claim semantic verification. Represent local readiness separately from live-byte readiness. Hash current required email/social and linked-article image files; explicit live verification performs bounded GET requests to fixed first-party production URLs, requires successful image MIME and exact expected bytes, and holds on 404, wrong bytes, wrong MIME, timeout or other unknown result. A live HEAD or stale preparation receipt cannot satisfy it. Add prepare-desk-email.mjs. Its default and --dry-run are network-free status/plan plus existing digest HTML/text preview; they must never load mail credentials, generate, publish or send. Explicit --generate composes existing scoped ChatGPT-plan generation/review/ingest/release, only for missing required story/kind targets. Explicit --verify-live performs readiness reads and reports pass/hold. No send option or mail-provider import exists in this preparation command. Scope desk-art-autopilot pending-image review and approved ingest to the exact parsed --story and --kind set, as well as generation/re-rolls. Validate unknown IDs/kinds. Preserve default scheduled behavior without explicit scope. Staged unrelated images must not enter a preparation run's review, re-roll, ingest, publication proof or generated receipt. Use the readiness module inside build-desk-dispatch-digest main before both test-recipient and subscriber-send side effects. Preserve early no-edition skip and existing armed/stale-issue checks. Once effective issue selection is known, hold the entire issue if any required image lacks reviewed local source or verified served bytes; do not silently omit the image or drop an art-unready selected story to pass. No Brevo listing, campaign creation/update/sendNow or test-send call may occur after a nonpassing art gate. Keep --dry-run useful even when art is unready: render a preview and list exact missing story/kind reasons and next preparation command, explicitly not send-ready. Add a distinct held-art outcome to workflow summaries so a green held run never claims mail was sent. Preserve arming approval, one-address test authorization, unsubscribe/disclosure content, daily campaign naming/idempotency and no retries on ambiguous sendNow. Expose package aliases and a short public-safe CLI guide explaining plan -> explicit generate/review/publish -> live verification -> existing separately authorized send. Existing art autopilot operates in its own origin/main worktree; preparation must distinguish that committed/published artifact from a possibly dirty caller checkout rather than silently pulling or rewriting the caller tree. The actual digest recomputes readiness from its current selected day and does not blindly trust a cached ready receipt. At actual rendering, bind reviewed source and current story/render inputs/producer hashes to the exact encoded derivatives; legacy absent proofs require real scoped rebuild, never hash-only retrofitting.
acceptance: A single network-free command for a date renders the existing email preview and reports ready/pending images with explicit reason codes and exact next commands; no model, provider, Git mutation, deployment, mail credential or send call occurs.

Explicit generation plans include only missing required images for actual selected stories; accepted imagery and unrelated staged backlog are preserved. Existing generation authentication, review, ingest, staging-first deployment and exact served-byte gates remain intact.

Both manual and scheduled actual digest send paths, including single-recipient test mode, make zero mail-provider calls when an image is missing, procedural, unreviewed, hash-drifted or not exactly verified live. Existing no-edition and arming behavior remains distinct.

A fully reviewed, hash-matching, live-matching fixture reaches the existing campaign/test-send branch exactly once, with original idempotency and ambiguous-send handling unchanged. A changed day selection or changed image invalidates prior readiness.

Declared satire is validated and required; an undeclared optional cartoon does not become a new email mandate. Current member-summary newsletter and website procedural-fallback cadence remain unchanged.

No real image-generation session, email, provider spend or deployment is needed for acceptance of the workflow code during this arc. Any actual image generation remains explicitly invoked outside the arc single-session constraint.
